# Physics tools

6 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `add_rigid_body`

Add a physics body node (RigidBody3D/2D, StaticBody3D/2D, CharacterBody3D/2D, AnimatableBody3D/2D) to the current scene

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node. Defaults to the class name (e.g. 'RigidBody3D'). |
| `body_type` | `string` | — | Physics body type (default: 'rigid') One of: `"rigid"`, `"static"`, `"character"`, `"animatable"`. |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Whether to create a 3D or 2D physics body (default: '3d') One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `mass` | `number` | — | Body mass in kg — only for rigid bodies (default: 1.0) |
| `gravity_scale` | `number` | — | Gravity multiplier — only for rigid bodies (default: 1.0) |
| `collision_layer` | `integer`, `array` | — | Bitmask (3 = layers 1+2) or 1-based layer numbers ([1, 3]) Array items are `integer`. |
| `collision_mask` | `integer`, `array` | — | Bitmask (3 = layers 1+2) or 1-based layer numbers ([1, 3]) Array items are `integer`. |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Position in local space (3D). For 2D use x/y only. Array items are `number`. |
| `rotation` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Rotation in degrees (3D Euler). For 2D pass a single number. Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/11-physics.json`, test PH-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "Body2D",
  "dimension": "2d",
  "position": "Vector2(100, 100)"
}
```

## `add_collision_shape`

Add a CollisionShape3D or CollisionShape2D node with a primitive shape resource. Typically added as a child of a physics body.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node (typically a PhysicsBody). Omit for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node (default: 'CollisionShape3D' or 'CollisionShape2D') |
| `shape_type` | `string` | — | Shape type. 3D: box, sphere, capsule, cylinder. 2D: rectangle, circle, capsule, segment. (default: 'box' for 3D, 'rectangle' for 2D) One of: `"box"`, `"sphere"`, `"capsule"`, `"cylinder"`, `"rectangle"`, `"circle"`, `"segment"`. |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Whether to create a 3D or 2D collision shape (default: '3d') One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `size` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Box size (3D) or rectangle size (2D, use x/y). Default: 1,1,1 (3D) or 20,20 (2D). Array items are `number`. |
| `radius` | `number` | — | Radius for sphere, capsule, cylinder, or circle shapes (default: 0.5 for 3D, 10 for 2D) |
| `height` | `number` | — | Height for capsule or cylinder shapes (default: 2.0 for 3D, 30 for 2D) |
| `point_a` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Start point for SegmentShape2D (default: -10,0) Array items are `number`. |
| `point_b` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | End point for SegmentShape2D (default: 10,0) Array items are `number`. |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Local position offset of the collision shape Array items are `number`. |
| `rotation` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Local rotation in degrees (3D only) Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/11-physics.json`, test PH-02:

```json
{
  "parent_path": "Body2D",
  "node_name": "Shape2D",
  "shape_type": "circle",
  "dimension": "2d",
  "radius": 32
}
```

## `set_collision_layer`

Set the collision_layer bitmask on a CollisionObject (PhysicsBody or Area). Determines which physics layer(s) the object occupies.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the CollisionObject node (PhysicsBody, Area, etc.) |
| `layers` | `integer`, `array` | yes | Bitmask (3 = layers 1+2) or 1-based layer numbers ([1, 3]) Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/11-physics.json`, test PH-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Body2D",
  "layers": [
    1,
    2
  ]
}
```

## `set_collision_mask`

Set the collision_mask bitmask on a CollisionObject or RayCast. Determines which layer(s) the object detects collisions with.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the CollisionObject or RayCast node |
| `layers` | `integer`, `array` | yes | Bitmask (3 = layers 1+2) or 1-based layer numbers ([1, 3]) Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/11-physics.json`, test PH-04:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Body2D",
  "layers": [
    1
  ]
}
```

## `add_raycast`

Add a RayCast3D or RayCast2D node to the scene. The ray fires from the node's origin toward target_position in local space.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node (default: 'RayCast3D' or 'RayCast2D') |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Whether to create a 3D or 2D raycast (default: '3d') One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `target_position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | End point of the ray in local space. Default: (0,-1,0) for 3D, (0,100) for 2D. Array items are `number`. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | — | Whether the raycast is active (default: true) |
| `collision_mask` | `integer`, `array` | — | Bitmask (3 = layers 1+2) or 1-based layer numbers ([1, 3]) Array items are `integer`. |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Local position of the RayCast node Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/11-physics.json`, test PH-05:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "Ray2D",
  "dimension": "2d",
  "target_position": "Vector2(0, 100)"
}
```

## `get_physics_info`

Get physics properties of a node: collision layer/mask, body type, mass, velocity (RigidBody), raycast state, and child CollisionShape details

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the physics node (PhysicsBody, Area, RayCast, etc.) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/11-physics.json`, test PH-06:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Body2D"
}
```
